description: Still from a Washington Post live stream of the George H.W. Bush state funeral at Washington National Cathedral, December 5 2018. In the front pew stand Donald Trump, Melania Trump, Barack Obama, Michelle Obama, Bill Clinton, Hillary Clinton, Jimmy Carter and Rosalynn Carter, most holding printed programs; Ivanka Trump, Joe Biden and Al Gore are visible in the rows behind. A red LIVE badge with the Washington Post logo sits top-left and a SUBSCRIBE button bottom-right.

Vertical collage of roughly a dozen photographs from Yellow Vest (gilets jaunes) protests in Europe and Canada showing QAnon symbols in the crowds: colored Q letter signs, Q logos and 'WWG1WGA' drawn on hi-vis yellow vests, 'Q sent me' vests at a night protest, and hand-made signs. French signs call for the resignation of Macron's party, the Rothschilds, and attack the Schiappa law; one Dutch sign fragment is visible. Attached to Q post 2566 under the filename 'TheWorldIsWatching', presenting the movement as spreading internationally.

description: Photograph at the Geographic South Pole marker in Antarctica. A person in black cold-weather gear with face fully covered kneels beside the ceremonial 'Geographic South Pole' sign holding a hand-drawn placard reading 'Q WWG1WGA'. A U.S. flag flies on a pole at right, the silver pole marker stands in front, and the Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station building is in the background. Attached to Q post 2566 as evidence 'the world is watching'.
text: Geographic South Pole. Roald Amundsen. December 14 1911. "So we arrived and were able to plant our flag at the geographical South Pole." Robert F. Scott. January 17, 1912. "The Pole. Yes, but under very different circumstances from those expected." elevation 9,301 feet. Q. WWG1WGA.
flags: The sign-holder's face is covered; a private individual, not identified

description: Annotated compilation arguing that Donald Trump lurked on 4chan's /pol/ on July 30 2016. Left side shows archived 4chan thread screenshots: a thread titled 'TRUMP RETWEETS A PEPE ACCOUNT' reacting to Trump retweeting the @patrioticpepe account, and a later thread where an anon asks Trump to use the word 'amazing' in his next tweet as a signal. Right side shows two @realDonaldTrump tweet screenshots — the @patrioticpepe retweet (with a Trump-as-Thomas-the-Tank-Engine meme image) and a tweet containing 'amazing' — connected by red arrows with yellow annotations '***He*** walks among us' and 'very next tweet'. The compilation presents this as proof Trump signals to the board; the coincidence is the image's claim, not established fact.

description: Screenshot (dark-mode mobile Twitter) of a tweet by The Trump Train (@The_Trump_Train) retweeted by Donald J. Trump, dated 28 Nov 2018. The tweet is a meme photoshopping political and law-enforcement figures behind prison bars — including Robert Mueller, John Podesta, Rod Rosenstein, Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, Huma Abedin, James Clapper, James Comey, Eric Holder, Bill Clinton and Loretta Lynch — under a caption asking when treason trials will begin now that 'Russia collusion is a proven lie'. The caption's assertions are the meme's claims, not established fact.
